What VerseKit does for you in Star Citizen

Blueprint tracker: new blueprints in seconds

Unlock a blueprint and it is in the list at once. VerseKit reads the game's own logs, without touching the game itself.

The overlay shows it right on top of the game: a narrow window, always on top, and it can let clicks pass through.

Contracts that bring you blueprints

In game, every contract shows which blueprints it hands out and which of those you are still missing. Without tabbing out.

Crafting: ingredients, times, prices

Ingredients, amounts, crafting time and price for every item, and whether you have the blueprint.

Mining and refining

Locations and concentration per material, plus a refinery comparison per ore. The best place shows in green.

Your hangar, your loadout

Which ships you own, what fits into them and what is still missing. With a total and a shopping route.

Trading with real profit

Shops, sell locations and routes that tell you what is left at the end. Not just what something costs.

Your statistics

Play time, ships, contracts, quantum jumps and crashes, counted from your game logs. They are kept even after the game deletes the logs.

Your look, your controls

Six colour schemes and any size you like. Plus: see which stick has which number, and set dead zones and curves.

What VerseKit writes into the game

VerseKit adds what the game's own texts leave out. Class, size and grade sit right next to a component's name. Every contract shows which blueprints it hands out, and below an item's description you see whether you already have its blueprint. Each part can be switched off, and “Remove again” restores the original texts character for character.

Cards or tabs, whichever you prefer

VerseKit starts in card view: every area as a card with a short explanation, the pages you use all the time pinned to the start page. Prefer everything in one bar on the left? Switch to tab view at the top right. The pages are the same.

Download VerseKit: ready in three steps

  1. Download

    An installer on Windows, a single file on Linux.

    Windows

    Installer

    VerseKit-Setup.exe Download for Windows

    Linux

    Single file

    VerseKit-x86_64.AppImage Download for Linux

    The buttons always download the latest version. See all versions

  2. Launch and set up

    On first start a wizard walks you through setup: language, finding Star Citizen, collecting your existing blueprints. It takes a minute.

    On first start Windows says “Windows protected your PC”. That happens with every program without an expensive certificate. Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”. The readme explains it with pictures.

    On Linux, make the file executable once: right-click, Properties, “Allow executing file as program”.

  3. Play

    Start Star Citizen as usual. VerseKit reads along and reports new blueprints at once. The program tells you about new versions itself and installs them at the push of a button.

Check it is genuine

Every version comes with a checksum. The value your system prints must appear in SHA256SUMS.txt Otherwise do not run the file.

Windows (Command Prompt in your downloads folder)

certutil -hashfile VerseKit-Setup.exe SHA256

Linux

sha256sum VerseKit-x86_64.AppImage

Virus scan: VirusTotal report for the current version

Is it safe?

The fair question before any download. Here is what VerseKit does and what it does not.

  • No hooks into the game

    No access to the game's memory, nothing is injected. VerseKit reads the logs Star Citizen writes itself, and only changes files you could also edit by hand. The only exception is the anti-AFK (Windows only, off by default): when switched on, it presses Alt+X every 5 minutes, just as you would yourself.

  • Open source

    Every line is public on GitHub. The files you download are built by GitHub itself from exactly this code.

  • Verified updates

    Every version comes with a checksum. An update is only installed if the file matches it exactly.

  • Free, no catch

    No paid tier, no ads, no sign-up. An error report only goes out when you send it yourself.

  • Stays with you

    No account, no cloud, no personal data. VerseKit only fetches reference data from sources that are meant for it, and counts itself once a day: without any ID, and you can switch that off.

The build has every version checked on VirusTotal; “Check it is genuine” above links the report. Individual scanners occasionally flag packed Python programs through machine-learning heuristics. That is a known false positive.

VerseKit is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games.

Frequently asked questions

How do I connect VerseKit to scmdb.net?
  1. In VerseKit, turn on “Connect to scmdb.net” under Settings → General.
  2. Sign in on scmdb.net and choose “Watcher” → “Enable Watcher”.
  3. Your browser asks once whether the site may access apps on this device: allow it, let it remember and reload the page.

You do not need to download scmdb's own watcher. It works with LIVE and HOTFIX.

Windows warns when I start it. Is that normal?

Yes. VerseKit is not digitally signed (yet), so Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”. Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”. The code is public on GitHub, and GitHub builds the files from it itself.

Which keyboard shortcuts work in game?

Ctrl+Alt+B brings the blueprint list to the front. On Windows, Ctrl+Alt+R reads the refinery terminal and then opens the storage with the lines it read. Both can be changed under Settings → Overlay.

Where is my data, and how do I back it up?

You can see and change the folder under Settings → Installation & paths (“Folder for your data”). A backup to take along is under Settings → Backup & reset.

How do I connect the KRT Profit Basetool?

Under Settings → Basetool, turn on the areas you want (blueprints, storage, hangar, unit demand) and click “Connect”. You sign in through your Basetool account in the browser. The “Unit demand” tab only appears with this connection.

When something does not work

Install, start, update

My antivirus flags VerseKit

A false alarm: programs packed into a single file like VerseKit are often flagged by mistake. The checksum shows whether your file is genuine: every version on GitHub comes with SHA256SUMS.txt, and the value there must match your file (on Windows: certutil -hashfile VerseKit-Setup.exe SHA256). If it matches, allow the file in your antivirus.

The update fails and the version stays old

Download the latest version above under “Download” and install it over the old one. Your data is kept. If the version still stays old, you are probably starting an old single .exe instead of the installation: start VerseKit from the Start menu.

Windows shows “Failed to remove temporary directory”
  1. Close the window with OK.
  2. Open Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc) and end every VerseKit entry.
  3. Press Windows+R, enter %TEMP% and delete the folders whose name starts with _MEI.
  4. Start VerseKit again.
Linux: the launch button does not start Star Citizen

On its own the button only finds the LUG Helper start script. If you play through Lutris, Heroic or Flatpak, enter your own command under Settings → Installation & paths → “Launch command for Star Citizen”.

In the game

My blueprint details have disappeared in the game

Every game patch and every translation update rewrites the game's text file, which drops the details. After a patch VerseKit inserts them again by itself; by hand it is under Game settings → Game → “Insert again”. Then quit Star Citizen completely and start it again, because the game only reads the file at startup. If a second translation tool runs alongside, the two overwrite each other: use only one.

The signature scanner shows nothing while mining

Look at the eye in the overlay bar. Grey means off: click it. Yellow means on but not reading: restart VerseKit once. Green means it is reading. If a number is not recognised, teach it under Mining & Salvage → Mining → “Teach digits”. The scanner is Windows only.

Your data

The blueprint list is missing blueprints I own

VerseKit counts what appeared in Star Citizen's logs since setup; the game deletes older logs itself. Compare once with the fabricator in the game and tick off what is missing in the blueprint list. If your inventory is already in the Basetool, on scmdb or in a file, bring it in under Settings → Backup & reset → “Import inventory”.

VerseKit remembers nothing, the statistics stay at 0

Usually the folder for your data is in OneDrive or somewhere VerseKit may not write to. Under Settings → Installation & paths → “Folder for your data”, choose a folder outside OneDrive, for example on D:.

Display

The text is blurry (4K or scaling above 100 %)

Turn on “Sharp rendering” under Settings → Appearance and restart VerseKit.

What belongs in an error report

If none of this helps, click “Report a problem” at the bottom right in VerseKit. The report goes straight to the developer, with personal folder names removed first.

  1. Version, system and the latest errors: the report adds them itself, nothing to copy.
  2. What you did, briefly and in order: which tab, which button.
  3. What should have happened and what happened instead.
  4. A picture of it. You can attach up to four to the report.
  5. If it concerns the game: whether LIVE or PTU.

If VerseKit does not start at all, ask on Discord and send the error message as a picture, plus Windows or Linux and which version you downloaded.
